visual_inspection.finding: IC6000 diagram identifies H21 as BOOT_SERIAL_IN and P7 as BOOT_MAIN.

BOOT_SERIAL_IN passes through R4003, marked XX, to the node labelled MULTI pin 9 UART_RX/BOOT_IN. An alternative footprint CM4003 is drawn in parallel. DEBUG_UART0_RXD reaches this node via R4002, also XX. AD_JACK_IN is the separate pin 10 net.

limits: The drawing does not prove R4003 or CM4003 fitted or an electrical path in this camera.
